title: Reckoner button
description: Square, unhurried buttons in medium-weight 14px type: a sand fill, a hairline outline and a solid linen/merlot fill. Every one eases its background, border and text colour over half a second to the primary colour on hover.
notes: secondary: sand → merlot on light themes, 10% linen → linen on dark ones
corners follow rounded-sm (square in the reckoner theme)
name: reckoner-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: secondary: sand fill (the usual one) · outline: hairline only · primary: solid primary fill

props.name: size
props.description: md: 46px tall, 14px text · lg: 56px tall, 16px text (the subscribe button)

props.name: asSpan
props.description: render a plain span styled as a button, for use inside a card that is already a link

props.name: type
props.description: button type when it isn't a link
